entities.name: Mowu
entities.description: Sapient legendary dog from Shenmeng and travel companion of Jiang Yanggu; can follow planeswalks.

entities.name: Mu Yanling
entities.description: Suggested Mowu is made of rock.

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: Witnessed Mowu change into stone as Yanggu and Mowu planeswalked from Ravnica.

entities.name: Interplanar Beacon
entities.description: Lured Yanggu and Mowu to Ravnica.

entities.name: Bolas
entities.description: Nicol Bolas, whose Immortal Sun trapped them on Ravnica.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact that trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: Alternate setting in which Mowu died.

events.summary: Yanggu and Mowu are lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon and trapped by the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Yanggu and Mowu fight against the Dreadhorde.
events.quote: They actively participated in the fight against the Dreadhorde

events.summary: In the Echoverse, Mowu is killed by unknown assailants and Yanggu seeks revenge.
events.quote: Mowu died at the hands of unknown assailants

relations.quote: the travel companion of the planeswalker Jiang Yanggu
